llm_response.reason: The website at https://velquronex.my/ displays a spoofed version of the Google homepage with official-looking Japanese text and links, despite the domain not being associated with Google. This is a clear case of mimicking legitimate company names, logos, and website designs (scam characteristic #16), which is a common tactic in phishing and scam sites designed to trick users. There is nothing to suggest it's a genuine Google property, making it a scam.
